page.title: wh語なしでも後ろから説明

analysis.summaryJa: 時間・場所・理由・方法の意味を持つ名詞は、when・where・why・howを置かずに説明節を直接続けられる。特にthe wayには方法の意味が含まれるためhowを重ねず、whereを使う節では場所を表すthereを重ねない。
grammarPoints: time・place・reason・wayを表す名詞に説明節を直接つなぐ形
the way＋節ではhowを併用しないこと
whereが場所の空所を担う節でthereを重複させないこと
everywhere・anywhereなどに節を続ける用法
visualEvidence: 画像のTIME・PLACE・REASON・WAYの4つの扉が、それぞれ名詞＋節を直接結ぶ入口として描かれている
the way you speakとthe way how you speakの正誤対比がある
ミニ練習でwhereとthereの場所表現の重複が取り除かれている
commonTraps: the way howと方法表現を二重にする
説明節を疑問文語順にする
先行する時間・場所名詞と節の意味関係を取り違える

questions.prompt: The day ------- will be listed in the project history.

choices.A: did the new portal go live
choices.B: when did the new portal go live
choices.C: the new portal went live
choices.D: the new portal did go live when

questions.translationJa: 新しいポータルが稼働を開始した日は、プロジェクト履歴に記載されます。
questions.explanationJa: dayは時間の入口なので、平叙文語順のthe new portal went liveを直接続けて説明できます。

questions.prompt: I appreciate the way ------- difficult customer calls.

choices.A: you handle
choices.B: how you handle
choices.C: do you handle
choices.D: you handling

questions.translationJa: 難しい顧客電話へのあなたの対応の仕方に感謝しています。
questions.explanationJa: the way自体に「どのように」が含まれるため、howを重ねずyou handleと続けます。

questions.prompt: The reason ------- was a missing signature on the order form.

choices.A: was the shipment held
choices.B: why the shipment held
choices.C: the shipment holding
choices.D: the shipment was held

questions.translationJa: 配送品が保留された理由は、注文書の署名漏れでした。
questions.explanationJa: reasonの後ろには主語＋動詞の説明節the shipment was heldを直接置けます。

questions.prompt: Please choose a place ------- without interrupting other teams.

choices.A: where can we hold the interview
choices.B: we can hold the interview
choices.C: we can hold the interview there
choices.D: can we hold the interview

questions.translationJa: ほかのチームを妨げずに面接を行える場所を選んでください。
questions.explanationJa: placeを説明する節は平叙文語順で、場所の空所を残したwe can hold the interviewが適切です。

questions.prompt: The moment -------, the reception staff will unlock the doors.

choices.A: the first guest arrives
choices.B: does the first guest arrive
choices.C: when the first guest will arrive
choices.D: the first guest arriving

questions.translationJa: 最初の来客が到着した瞬間に、受付係がドアを開けます。
questions.explanationJa: momentは時間を表すため、the first guest arrivesという節を直接続けられます。

questions.prompt: Our driver may stop anywhere ------- legally marked for deliveries.

choices.A: where the curb is there
choices.B: is the curb
choices.C: the curb is
choices.D: the curb be

questions.translationJa: 運転手は、配送用として合法的に表示された縁石ならどこでも停車できます。
questions.explanationJa: anywhereの後ろにthe curb isという平叙文の節を続け、停車可能な場所を説明します。

questions.prompt: Could you show me the way ------- these expense codes?

choices.A: how the finance team applies
choices.B: the finance team applies
choices.C: does the finance team apply
choices.D: the finance team applying

questions.translationJa: 財務チームがこれらの経費コードを適用する方法を教えていただけますか。
questions.explanationJa: the wayの後ろはhowなしでthe finance team appliesという説明節を置きます。
questions.focus: 方法名詞wayに直接続く節

questions.prompt: The week ------- is usually our busiest sales period.

choices.A: when begins the holiday campaign
choices.B: does the holiday campaign begin
choices.C: the holiday campaign beginning
choices.D: the holiday campaign begins

questions.translationJa: 年末キャンペーンが始まる週は、通常、最も販売が忙しい期間です。
questions.explanationJa: weekという時間名詞の直後に主語＋動詞の節を置いて、その週を特定しています。

questions.prompt: We finally discovered the reason ------- during checkout.

choices.A: were customers leaving
choices.B: customers leaving why
choices.C: customers were leaving
choices.D: why were customers leaving

questions.translationJa: 私たちはついに、顧客が会計途中で離脱していた理由を突き止めました。
questions.explanationJa: reasonの内容は平叙文語順のcustomers were leavingで直接説明できます。

questions.prompt: The courier can wait wherever ------- a loading zone.

choices.A: does the building provide
choices.B: the building provides there
choices.C: provides the building
choices.D: the building provides

questions.translationJa: 配送業者は、建物に搬入口が設けられている所ならどこでも待機できます。
questions.explanationJa: whereverの後ろはthe building provides a loading zoneという完全な平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a product launch date.

choices.A: I remember the morning when did the application become available.
choices.B: I remember the morning the application became available.
choices.C: I remember the morning did the application become available.
choices.D: I remember the morning the application available became when.

questions.translationJa: 私はそのアプリが利用可能になった朝を覚えています。
questions.explanationJa: morningの後ろに平叙文語順の説明節the application became availableを直接続けています。
questions.focus: 時間名詞を説明する節

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a trainer’s method.

choices.A: The team likes the way how Ms. Ortiz explains the procedure.
choices.B: The team likes the way does Ms. Ortiz explain the procedure.
choices.C: The team likes how the way Ms. Ortiz explains the procedure.
choices.D: The team likes the way Ms. Ortiz explains the procedure.

questions.translationJa: チームはオルティスさんの手順説明の仕方を気に入っています。
questions.explanationJa: the wayとhowを重ねず、the way＋主語＋動詞の形にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the cause of an outage.

choices.A: The reason the server stopped is still unclear.
choices.B: The reason did the server stop is still unclear.
choices.C: The reason the server stop is still unclear.
choices.D: The reason why did the server stop is still unclear.

questions.translationJa: サーバーが停止した理由はまだ不明です。
questions.explanationJa: reasonをthe server stoppedという完結した説明節が後ろから修飾しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about selecting a meeting location.

choices.A: This is the room where we met the supplier there.
choices.B: This is the room where did we meet the supplier.
choices.C: This is the room where we met the supplier.
choices.D: This is the room we met the supplier where there.

questions.translationJa: ここが私たちが仕入先と会った部屋です。
questions.explanationJa: whereが場所を表すため、節内にthereを重ねません。また節は平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a recurring delivery time.

choices.A: The packages arrive about the time does the front desk open.
choices.B: The packages arrive about the time when opens the front desk.
choices.C: The packages arrive about the time the front desk opening.
choices.D: The packages arrive about the time the front desk opens.

questions.translationJa: 荷物は受付が開く頃に到着します。
questions.explanationJa: timeの後ろにthe front desk opensを直接つなぎ、到着時刻を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about access to branch offices.

choices.A: Technicians may work wherever does the company have an office.
choices.B: Technicians may work wherever the company has an office.
choices.C: Technicians may work wherever the company has an office there.
choices.D: Technicians may work where every the company has an office.

questions.translationJa: 技術者は会社に事務所がある所ならどこでも勤務できます。
questions.explanationJa: whereverの後ろには平叙文語順のthe company has an officeを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence asking about a filing method.

choices.A: Please demonstrate the way how you label archived records.
choices.B: Please demonstrate the way do you label archived records.
choices.C: Please demonstrate the way you label archived records.
choices.D: Please demonstrate how the way you label archived records.

questions.translationJa: 保管記録にラベルを付ける方法を実演してください。
questions.explanationJa: wayの方法の意味とhowを二重にせず、you labelという節を直接続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence identifying a reason for a refund.

choices.A: We understand the reason the customer requested a refund.
choices.B: We understand the reason requested the customer a refund.
choices.C: We understand the reason did the customer request a refund.
choices.D: We understand the reason the customer request a refund.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは顧客が返金を求めた理由を理解しています。
questions.explanationJa: the customer requested a refundはreasonを説明する平叙文語順の節です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about seating during a workshop.

choices.A: Participants may sit anywhere can they see the screen clearly.
choices.B: Participants may sit anywhere where they can see the screen there.
choices.C: Participants may sit anywhere they can clearly the screen see.
choices.D: Participants may sit anywhere they can see the screen clearly.

questions.translationJa: 参加者は画面がはっきり見える所ならどこに座っても構いません。
questions.explanationJa: anywhereにthey can see the screen clearlyを直接続け、可能な場所を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence recalling a deadline.

choices.A: Do you remember the day were the signed forms due?
choices.B: Do you remember the day did the signed forms due?
choices.C: Do you remember the day the signed forms were due?
choices.D: Do you remember the day the signed forms due were when?

questions.translationJa: 署名済み書類の期限だった日を覚えていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 文全体は疑問文でも、dayを説明する内側の節はthe signed forms were dueという平叙文語順です。
questions.focus: 主文の疑問と説明節の語順

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I recall the year our regional office opened."

choices.A: I recall why our regional office opened that year.
choices.B: I recall where our regional office opened.
choices.C: I recall how the year opened our regional office.
choices.D: I recall the year when our regional office opened.

questions.translationJa: 私は地域事務所が開設された年を覚えています。
questions.explanationJa: 時間名詞yearの後ろではwhenを省略して節を直接続けても同じ意味になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Tell me how you organize the inventory."

choices.A: Tell me the way how the inventory organizes you.
choices.B: Tell me the way you organize the inventory.
choices.C: Tell me where you organize the inventory.
choices.D: Tell me the reason you organize the inventory.

questions.translationJa: 在庫を整理する方法を教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: how you organizeとthe way you organizeは同じ方法を表し、the way howとはしません。
questions.focus: how節とthe way節の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We know why the invoice was rejected."

choices.A: We know the place the invoice was rejected.
choices.B: We know when the invoice rejected the reason.
choices.C: We know the reason the invoice was rejected.
choices.D: We know the way the invoice accepted.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは請求書が却下された理由を知っています。
questions.explanationJa: why節はthe reason＋説明節で言い換えられ、理由の内容を保ちます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "That is where the orientation took place."

choices.A: That is the place the orientation took place.
choices.B: That is the reason the orientation took place.
choices.C: That is the time the orientation took place.
choices.D: That is how the orientation took place.

questions.translationJa: そこがオリエンテーションが行われた場所です。
questions.explanationJa: whereの場所意味はthe place＋節で表せます。節の中にthereを足す必要はありません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You may print the document wherever a secure printer is available."

choices.A: You may print the document whenever a secure printer is available.
choices.B: You may print the document anywhere a secure printer is available.
choices.C: You may print the document for the reason a printer is secure.
choices.D: You may print anywhere the document is a secure printer.

questions.translationJa: 安全なプリンターが利用できる所ならどこでも、その文書を印刷できます。
questions.explanationJa: whereverとanywhere＋説明節はいずれも「～する所ならどこでも」を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I dislike how the vendor packages fragile items."

choices.A: I dislike the place the vendor packages fragile items.
choices.B: I dislike the reason fragile items package the vendor.
choices.C: I dislike the time the vendor delivers fragile items.
choices.D: I dislike the way the vendor packages fragile items.

questions.translationJa: 私は仕入先の壊れ物の梱包方法が気に入りません。
questions.explanationJa: how the vendor packagesはthe way the vendor packagesと同じ方法を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Monday was when the maintenance began."

choices.A: Monday was the day the maintenance began.
choices.B: Monday was the place the maintenance began.
choices.C: Monday was the reason the maintenance began.
choices.D: Monday was the way the maintenance began.

questions.translationJa: 月曜日が保守作業の始まった日でした。
questions.explanationJa: whenで示した時間はthe day＋説明節へ自然に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The manager explained why the schedule changed."

choices.A: The manager explained the place the schedule changed.
choices.B: The schedule explained the way the manager changed.
choices.C: The manager explained the reason the schedule changed.
choices.D: The manager explained when the reason scheduled.

questions.translationJa: 部長は予定が変更された理由を説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: why the schedule changedはthe reason the schedule changedと同じ理由内容です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Stay wherever you can receive a strong signal."

choices.A: Stay anywhere you can receive a strong signal.
choices.B: Stay whenever you can receive a strong signal.
choices.C: Stay the reason you can receive a strong signal.
choices.D: Stay anywhere can you receive a strong signal.

questions.translationJa: 強い電波を受信できる所ならどこにいても構いません。
questions.explanationJa: whereverはanywhere＋節と同義で、場所の自由選択を表します。
questions.focus: 複合関係副詞の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This is how our team reviews urgent claims."

choices.A: This is the way how does our team review urgent claims.
choices.B: This is the way our team reviews urgent claims.
choices.C: This is the reason our team reviews urgent claims.
choices.D: This is the place our team reviews urgent claims there.

questions.translationJa: これが私たちのチームが緊急請求を審査する方法です。
questions.explanationJa: howで表した方法をthe way＋平叙文節で表せます。the way howとはしません。

questions.prompt: The support team documents every major incident. Yesterday was the day ------- for the first time.

choices.A: did the backup system fail
choices.B: when did the backup system fail
choices.C: the backup system failed
choices.D: the backup system failing

questions.translationJa: サポートチームは重大な障害をすべて記録します。昨日はバックアップシステムが初めて故障した日でした。
questions.explanationJa: dayの後ろに平叙文語順のthe backup system failedを直接続けます。

questions.prompt: Please observe Ms. Park during the demonstration. We want you to learn the way ------- each device.

choices.A: she inspects
choices.B: how she inspects
choices.C: does she inspect
choices.D: she inspecting

questions.translationJa: 実演中のパクさんを観察してください。各機器を点検する彼女の方法を学んでほしいのです。
questions.explanationJa: the wayにhowを重ねず、she inspectsという節を続けます。

questions.prompt: The delivery arrived late, but the road was clear. We are investigating the reason ------- at the depot.

choices.A: did the truck remain
choices.B: the truck remaining why
choices.C: was the truck remain
choices.D: the truck remained

questions.translationJa: 配送は遅れましたが、道路は空いていました。トラックが配送所に留まった理由を調査しています。
questions.explanationJa: reasonの後ろにはthe truck remained at the depotという平叙文節が入ります。

questions.prompt: The lobby is too noisy for interviews. Let us find a place ------- privately.

choices.A: can candidates speak
choices.B: candidates can speak
choices.C: candidates can speak there
choices.D: where can candidates speak

questions.translationJa: ロビーは面接には騒がしすぎます。応募者が個別に話せる場所を探しましょう。
questions.explanationJa: placeの後ろに場所の空所を含むcandidates can speak privatelyを置きます。

questions.prompt: Our annual sale starts tomorrow. This is the time ------- most customer questions.

choices.A: do we receive
choices.B: when receive we
choices.C: we receive
choices.D: we receiving

questions.explanationJa: timeの後ろをwe receive most customer questionsという節が説明しています。

questions.prompt: The manual is accurate, but new employees find it dense. I will revise the way ------- the safety steps.

choices.A: it presents
choices.B: how it presents
choices.C: does it present
choices.D: it presenting

questions.prompt: The branch has several unused rooms. We can set up a temporary desk anywhere ------- reliable Wi-Fi.

choices.C: employees can access there

questions.prompt: The client accepted the revised estimate immediately. I understand the reason ------- now.

choices.A: was the sales director confident

choices.C: the sales director confident
choices.D: the sales director was confident

questions.explanationJa: reasonを説明する内側の節は疑問語順にせず、主語＋動詞の順にします。
questions.focus: 埋め込み節の平叙文語順

questions.prompt: The security gate opens at six. Staff who arrive earlier must wait until the moment ------- on duty.

choices.A: a guard comes
choices.B: does a guard come
choices.C: when a guard will come

questions.translationJa: 警備ゲートは6時に開きます。それより早く来た職員は、警備員が勤務に来る時まで待たなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: momentの時間をa guard comes on dutyという現在形の節が直接説明します。

questions.prompt: The old process confused several customers. Our designer showed us the way ------- without extra labels.

choices.A: how the form could be simplified
choices.B: the form could be simplified
choices.C: could the form be simplified
choices.D: the form could simplify it

questions.translationJa: 以前の手続きは複数の顧客を混乱させました。デザイナーは追加ラベルなしでフォームを簡潔にできる方法を示しました。
questions.explanationJa: the wayの後ろにhowを置かず、受動形の平叙文節the form could be simplifiedを続けます。
